text:
alice: kickoff — starting canary deploy for runtime v3.2 (+kernel batching) to 10% traffic. router header-swap (x-rd-route) enabled on canary route. pin api to v2.9 for compatibility. rolling window 23:00–01:00 UTC. anyone seeing immediate issues call rollback.

ben: noted, I'll watch console metrics. will disable autoscale if latency spikes.

deploy-bot: deploy started: runtime:v3.2 -> canary group cg-7 (10% traffic). router-change queued. track_id=ddb-1768812345

dana: quick question — does v3.2 change KV eviction defaults? runtime changelog says eviction aggressive = true.

alice: yes, eviction aggressive on by default to free KV for batching. we've tested on staging, but it may increase cold-start latencies for long-lived sessions.

eric: tagging observability: @sre-bot set alert: latency_p50>220ms for 3m or error_rate>0.8% => rollback.

sre-bot: alert rule created by eric: latency_p50>220ms (3m), error_rate>0.8% (3m). notifying #eng-oncall.

ben: console shows no errors yet. but router logs show a small uptick in 502s from api:v2.9 -> runtime:v3.2

alice: can you paste a sample log?

ben: pasted:
`router: upstream 502 from runtime-cg7 instance-12 session-id=abc123 header_x_rd_route=canary`
`api: 2024-11-02T23:01:12Z trace=tx-981`

dana: that looks like a protocol mismatch — runtime kernel changed how late-arrival KV slices are handled. router's header swap may be exposing an edge case.

alice: ok hold traffic to canary at 0% while we validate. ben, deploy-bot, pause traffic-shift.

deploy-bot: action: traffic_shift pause issued by alice. canary -> 0% in 8s. status=paused.

eric: recommend pinning router to previous header behavior for canary routes until fix. can we flip router flag?

ben: router flag flip in progress: `routerctl set-flag x-rd-route-preserve=true --env canary`. ETA 30s.

dana: also rolling back KV eviction to staging defaults on runtime instances in cg-7 while we patch.

alice: decision: rollback criteria met if p50 > 220ms for 5m OR 502 spike >0.8% for 3m. for now, keep runtime v3.2 stopped until we validate kernel patch. update release notes and release channels: console->release-notes team, api docs pinned.

ben: updating release notes: "Runtime v3.2: batching and eviction changes. Router header-swap experimental — disabled for canary pending compatibility fix."

deploy-bot: canary instances cg-7 runtime:v3.2 currently draining. rollback-ready snapshot created: snapshot-1768812345-rollback. safe-pin api:v2.9 confirmed.

eric: I'll coordinate rollback if alerts fire. also posting a brief note to #incidents if we need paged rollback.

alice: thanks all. next steps: dana to test kernel patch in staging, ben to confirm router flag behavior in canary, eric to monitor alerts; we'll reschedule full rollout once green.

dana: starting staging validation now. will post results in 30m.

ben: console note: created runbook entry `runbooks/runtime-v3.2-compat.md` and linked to release.
